# RW normalized LP (no clamp iterations but restart)
import numpy as np
idx={n:i for i,n in enumerate(sorted(nodes))}
N=len(idx)

for n,l in labels.items(): Y[idx[n],l]=1.0
A=np.zeros((N,N))
for u,v in edges:
  A[idx[u],idx[v]]=1; A[idx[v],idx[u]]=1
D=A.sum(1)
# normalized adjacency with self loops
for sl in [0.0,0.5,1.0]:
  At=A+np.eye(N)*sl
  d=At.sum(1)
  Dm=np.diag(1/np.sqrt(np.maximum(d,1e-9)))
  An=Dm@At@Dm
  for T in [1,2,3,5,10]:
    Z=np.linalg.matrix_power(An,T)@Y
    p=Z[idx[45]]
    print('GCN sl',sl,'T',T,'pred',int(np.argmax(p)),np.round(p,3))
